about: Which PRs reach customers or production and so need a checker crew on a different model before firstmate_merge (owner decision Q8). A repo not listed here reaches production. A changed file that matches productionPaths always reaches production. A PR whose every other changed file matches internalPaths is internal and self-checks. A repo listed with reach internal never needs a checker. A path ending in / is a folder at any depth; a leading / anchors it at the repo root; any other pattern matches the file name, with * as a wildcard. A repo name may use * too. A repo row may add its own productionPaths, such as the folder it deploys from.
